_note: 學習路徑內容建置・虛擬語氣：未來的假設：較不可能／純假想（eng.t_sub.subj.future-unreal，學測／分科級）。If ＋ 主詞 ＋ should ＋ 原形（萬一、較不可能）；If ＋ 主詞 ＋ were to ＋ 原形（純假想、較不可能的未來）；主句用 would／could／might ＋ 原形（should 型主句也可用祈使句）。高階防第二正解：鎖定 should／were to 後接原形，區分與一般真實未來（If ＋ 現在式, will）的差異。皆標準英語，形式依 Cambridge / Oxford；claim 標 provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。文法單元無音檔。

units.title_zh: 未來的假設：較不可能／純假想（If ... should / were to）
units.can_do: 我能用 If ＋ should ＋ 原形（萬一、較不可能）和 If ＋ were to ＋ 原形（純假想、較不可能的未來）表達對未來的假設，並能分辨它與真實未來（If ＋ 現在式, will）的差別。
units.situation_group: 假設語氣 未來假設 should / were to
units.subject: eng

claims.text: To talk about a future possibility that is unlikely but imaginable, use 'If + subject + should + base form': If you should see him, give him my message.
claims.verification_ref: 較不可能的未來＝If ＋ should ＋ 原形（萬一）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: To present a future as more hypothetical or tentative (often less likely), use 'If + subject + were to + base form': If I were to win the lottery, I would travel the world.
claims.verification_ref: 假想、較不可能的未來＝If ＋ were to ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The main clause normally uses 'would / could / might + base form': If the plan were to fail, we would need a backup.
claims.verification_ref: 主句用 would／could／might ＋ 原形；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: An ordinary, likely future uses the real conditional 'If + present simple, ... will + base'; the should / were to forms mark the future as less likely or purely hypothetical.
claims.verification_ref: 一般可能未來＝直說 If ＋ 現在式, will；should／were to 標示較不可能或純假想；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To talk about a future event that is possible but unlikely, use 'If + subject + should + base form'. It often means 'if by any chance'. The main clause can use 'would / could / might + base', or sometimes an imperative: 'If you should need help, just call me.'
teach.zh_hint: 要講「未來有可能、但較不可能」的事，用 If ＋ 主詞 ＋ should ＋ 原形，常帶「萬一」的語氣。主句可用 would／could／might ＋ 原形，有時也可用祈使句：If you should need help, just call me。

teach.body: If you should see Tom, please give him this letter.
teach.zh_hint: 萬一你見到湯姆，請把這封信給他。should see＝萬一見到（較不可能），主句用祈使句。

teach.body: To present a future as more hypothetical or tentative (often less likely), use 'If + subject + were to + base form'. 'Were to' uses 'were' for all persons and is followed by the base verb, and the main clause takes 'would / could / might + base': 'If the sun were to rise in the west, I would believe anything.'
teach.zh_hint: 要把未來講得更假想、較不可能（帶距離感），用 If ＋ 主詞 ＋ were to ＋ 原形。were to 各人稱都用 were、後接原形，主句用 would／could／might ＋ 原形：If the sun were to rise in the west, I would believe anything。

teach.body: If I were to lose my job, I would start my own business.
teach.zh_hint: 假如我真的丟了工作，我就會自己創業。were to lose＝純假想的未來，主句 would ＋ 原形。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（萬一、較不可能的未來）：If you ____ change your mind, let me know.（萬一你改變心意，告訴我一聲）

distractor_rationales.will: will 不放進這種『萬一』的 if 子句；表達較不可能的未來用 If ＋ should ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.would: would 用在主句，不用在表示『萬一』的 if 子句開頭；此處用 should。
distractor_rationales.shall: shall change 不是這個句型；『萬一』用 should ＋ 原形（change）。

practice.feedback: 較不可能的未來用 If ＋ should ＋ 原形：If you should change your mind, let me know。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式（假想、較不可能的未來）：If I ____ win the lottery, I would travel around the world.（假如我中了樂透，我就會環遊世界）

distractor_rationales.am to: were to 各人稱都用 were（不是 am）；am to 不是這個假想未來句型。
distractor_rationales.will: will 不放進 if 子句（不能說 If I will win）；真實可能的未來是把現在式放進 if 子句（If I win the lottery, I will...），而這裡是假想、較不可能，用 were to ＋ 原形。
distractor_rationales.would: would 用在主句（would travel）；if 子句用 were to ＋ 原形。

practice.feedback: 假想、較不可能的未來用 If ＋ were to ＋ 原形：If I were to win the lottery, I would travel。

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式：If the plan were to fail, we ____ need a backup plan.（假如這個計畫失敗，我們就會需要備案）

distractor_rationales.will: if 子句用了 were to（假想未來），主句要用 would／could／might ＋ 原形，不是 will。
distractor_rationales.were to: were to 用在 if 子句，不用在主句；主句用 would need。
distractor_rationales.should: 此處主句表達假想結果，用 would；should 用在 if 子句表『萬一』。

practice.feedback: 主句用 would／could／might ＋ 原形：we would need a backup plan。

practice.stem: 選出表達「假想、較不可能的未來」的句子（而非真實可能的未來）：
practice.answer: If humans were to live on Mars, life would be very different.
options: If humans were to live on Mars, life would be very different.
If it rains this afternoon, we will take an umbrella.
If you finish early, we will go out.
If the bus comes soon, we will not be late.

distractor_rationales.If it rains this afternoon, we will take: If ＋ 現在式, will 是真實可能的未來（直說），不是假想未來。
If ＋ 現在式, will，真實可能的條件，非假想。
distractor_rationales.If the bus comes soon, we will not be la: If ＋ 現在式, will，真實可能的未來，非假想、較不可能的用法。

practice.feedback: 假想、較不可能的未來用 were to ＋ 原形：If humans were to live on Mars, life would be very different。

practice.stem: 用 were to 改寫成『假想、較不可能的未來』：'Imagine the company closing down; what would you do?'（寫出：If the company ____ ..., what would you do?）
practice.answer: If the company were to close down, what would you do?
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：假想未來用 were to ＋ 原形，主句 would ＋ 原形：If the company were to close down, what would you do?

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 純文字朗讀＋語調模仿（無音檔，自己朗讀→自評）：should／were to 稍清楚以傳達『萬一／純假想』的語氣；主句 would 稍強調，句尾下收。

lines.text: If you should need anything, just call the front desk.
lines.intonation: should need 稍清楚、祈使主句語氣下收

lines.text: If I were to start again, I would choose a different path.
lines.intonation: were to 連讀、would choose 稍強調、句尾下收
